# Grillz of Punjab

> Pure vegetarian restro and cafe in Dhampur, District Bijnor, Uttar Pradesh, India.

Grillz of Punjab serves Indian, Punjabi tandoori and Chinese food, pizza, thali combos and cafe drinks. The kitchen is 100% vegetarian. Free home delivery on orders above Rs. 499.

## Facts

- Name: Grillz of Punjab (Restro and Cafe)
- Type: Pure veg restaurant and cafe
- Address: Opposite Axis Bank, Near Punjabi Colony, Dhampur, District Bijnor, Uttar Pradesh 246761, India
- Hours: Daily 12:00 PM – 11:00 PM
- Phone / WhatsApp: +91 63953 66055
- Delivery line: +91 74549 51842
- Price range: ₹
- Cuisine: Indian, Punjabi, Tandoori, Chinese, Pizza, Cafe, Vegetarian
- Landmark: Near Punjabi Colony, opposite Axis Bank; short ride from Dhampur Railway Station

## Signature dishes

- Paneer Tikka — ₹230
- Malai Chaap — Half ₹100 · Full ₹170
- Special Meal thali — ₹199
- Chhole Bhature — ₹80 (paneer ₹110)
